item.title: FKA twigs & Lil Yachty, Myles Smith, Kashus Culpepper & More: New Music Friday Guide
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We're diving into the hottest new releases that are trending on Billboard. Let's get started!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "First up, British singer-songwriter Myles Smith has just dropped his debut studio album, 'My Mess, My Heart, My Life'. This highly anticipated release comes two years after his breakout hit 'Stargazing' and three EPs later. We can't wait to hear what he has in store for us."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Next, FKA twigs has teamed up with Lil Yachty for a summer smash called 'On Your Mind'. This punchy, crunchy collab marks twigs' first release since winning the 2026 Grammy for Best Dance/Electronic Album. The song is a thrilling three and a half minutes of hyperpop goodness. FKA twigs shared the backstory of this song, revealing it was written during a tough time when she found out she wouldn't be able to perform at Coachella due to visa issues."
[Short music clip: "On Your Mind" by FKA twigs & Lil Yachty]
Host: "We also have a new release from Coco & Breezy, who have linked up with Gavin Turek for the slinky summer house track 'Tonight'. This groovy heater is perfect for the summer season, with a relaxed and feminine vibe. Coco & Breezy are on tour all summer, so be sure to catch them live if you can."
[Short music transition]
Host: "These are just a few of the exciting new releases out this week. For more, check out Billboard's Friday Music Guide for the full list of essential releases. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music plays]
